# The race detector randomizes the scheduler, which GOEXPERIMENT=detsched
# makes deterministic, so the two can't be combined.

env GOEXPERIMENT=detsched
! go build -race .
stderr '^go: -race is not supported with GOEXPERIMENT=detsched$'

-- go.mod --
module m

go 1.27
-- main.go --
package main

func main() {}
